name: Maine Printing & Embroidery
old_description: Screen printing is at the ready with both manual and automatic equipment.
about:
Maine Printing & Embroidery operates from Warren, a coastal community in Maine's Mid Coast region. The family‑owned shop has been in business for more than 40 years, though a specific founding year is not published. The company began as a local screen printing and embroidery provider and has since expanded into a full‑service graphics and signage operation.

The facility houses both manual and automatic screen printing presses, enabling runs from a few custom tees to orders of several hundred pieces. In addition to screen printing, the shop offers embroidery, CAD‑cut vinyl graphics, banner and decal production, vehicle wraps, and general signage. An in‑house art department staffed with several artists handles original artwork, custom shirt designs, and vehicle‑wrap layouts, keeping all design and production under one roof.

The customer base includes businesses and organizations needing branded apparel, promotional items, fleet graphics, and interior or exterior signage. Small orders of just a couple of shirts are accommodated through vinyl cut graphics, while larger volumes move to screen printing. The shop also serves clients requiring vehicle identification, wall graphics, and business identification signage.

The company attributes its longevity to professionalism and quality, emphasizing that multiple services under one roof and an in‑house art team allow for prompt turnaround and consistent results. Family ownership remains a stated point of differentiation, with the owners highlighting personal service and direct communication.
